# Schemas

<!-- Generated from dna-codes-platform. Do not edit here: the next sync overwrites it. -->

JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for the two DNA vocabularies:

- `structure/` — `structure/v1`: domain, entity, attribute and relationship.
- `behaviour/` — `behaviour/v1`: behaviour, action, operation, workflow, condition and policy.

The `describe` tool on the DNA MCP server returns the same definitions. See https://dna.codes/agents/.
